WITH LatestTelemetry AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node_id)
    node_id,
    -- 1. Catch all variations of Unknown
    CASE 
      WHEN hardware_model IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
      WHEN TRIM(hardware_model::text) IN ('', '0') THEN 'Unknown'
      WHEN hardware_model::text ILIKE '%unknown%' THEN 'Unknown'
      WHEN hardware_model::text ILIKE '%unset%' THEN 'Unknown'
      ELSE hardware_model::text 
    END AS clean_model
  FROM node_telemetry
  WHERE $__timeFilter(device_time) 
    AND LOWER(REPLACE(node_id::text, '!', '')) NOT IN ('ffffffff', '^all', 'all')
  ORDER BY node_id, device_time DESC 
),
ModelCounts AS (
  -- 2. Get the base counts for everything
  SELECT 
    clean_model,
    COUNT(node_id) AS total_nodes
  FROM LatestTelemetry
  WHERE LOWER(clean_model) != 'broadcast' 
  GROUP BY clean_model
),
RankedKnowns AS (
  -- 3. Rank ONLY the known hardware models
  SELECT 
    clean_model,
    total_nodes,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY total_nodes DESC) as rn
  FROM ModelCounts
  WHERE clean_model != 'Unknown'
),
FinalSlices AS (
  -- 4a. Take the Top 23 exact models
  SELECT clean_model AS "Hardware Model", total_nodes 
  FROM RankedKnowns 
  WHERE rn <= 23
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- 4b. Crush everything ranked 24+ into 'Other'
  SELECT 'Other' AS "Hardware Model", SUM(total_nodes) AS total_nodes 
  FROM RankedKnowns 
  WHERE rn > 23 
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- 4c. Grab the dedicated 'Unknown' bucket
  SELECT clean_model AS "Hardware Model", total_nodes 
  FROM ModelCounts 
  WHERE clean_model = 'Unknown'
)

-- 5. Output and lock in the display order
SELECT 
  "Hardware Model", 
  total_nodes AS "Total Nodes"
FROM FinalSlices
ORDER BY 
  -- 📍 The Enforcer: Tells the SQL engine exactly where to place these two rows
  CASE 
    WHEN "Hardware Model" = 'Unknown' THEN 3
    WHEN "Hardware Model" = 'Other' THEN 2
    ELSE 1
  END ASC,
  -- 📍 Sort everything else (the top 23) normally by their size
  "Total Nodes" DESC;
